origin: it should NOT report functions inside `quote`
source:
@spec to_def(t(), atom()) :: Macro.t()
def to_def(%__MODULE__{vars: vars, code: code}, name) do
  quote generated: true do
    def unquote(name)(unquote_splicing(vars)) do
      unquote(code)
    end
  end
end
